items.title: Wendy's has a massive problem: It's closing restaurants left and right
items.summary: It's been a brutal run for Wendy's.

items.title: Yum China completes $1.2bn acquisition of Pizza Hut brand in China
items.summary: The deal will transfer ownership of the Pizza Hut brand to Yum China, which has been operating the chain locally for 36 years.

items.title: Yum China officially takes ownership of Pizza Hut China
items.summary: The sale closed last week for $1.2 billion, allowing Yum China to be more flexible with the brand to meet market-specific preferences.

items.title: When Food Scares Serve Up Healthy Profits
items.summary: It’s any restaurant chain’s nightmare—instead of making a run for the border, diners make one for the toilet.  The latest food scare casualties are Taco Bell owner  Yum Brands  and salad chain  Sweetgreen  hit by cyclosporiasis.  Neither is responsible for the outbreak, and Sweetgreen’s customers haven’t even been sickened, but that doesn’t matter.

items.title: Parasite Outbreak Fears Crush Restaurant Sales Weeks After RFK Jr. Said It Was “Under Control”
items.summary: Three weeks after a Cabinet secretary declared a parasite outbreak under control, a national salad chain collapsed into bankruptcy and a healthy food brand that never even stocked the recalled lettuce watched its stock crater 35 percent.

items.title: Taylor Farms Pulls Salsa and Guacamole Over Salmonella Concerns

items.title: MCD Stock Forecast: Here’s Where It’ll End The Year
items.summary: McDonald's has lost ground all year, and the bear case carries real teeth, but a combination of loyalty scale, a new U.S. president, and a beverage platform rolling out ahead of plan may tell a different story by December.

items.title: Michigan says it’s OK to start eating salads again as cyclospora outbreak wanes
items.summary: The state, which has been at the center of the biggest cyclospora outbreak in the U.S., said this week that the number new cases of cyclosporiasis has fallen.
